glance.question: How do Christians come to know the Bible well?

positions.name: Systematic Study & Interpretation
positions.claim: Literacy comes through careful, methodical study of grammar, context and the author's intent.

positions.name: Devotional Encounter & Transformation
positions.claim: Knowing Scripture means meeting God in it, through meditation the Spirit uses to change the heart.

positions.name: Communal Interpretation & Church Formation
positions.claim: The church learns Scripture together, through worship, teaching, small groups and pastoral care.

start_here.title: Let’s Talk about Our Bible Literacy Problem
start_here.author: Jen Wilkin
start_here.why: Defines Bible literacy plainly and explains why it does not grow by accident.

start_here.title: How Do I Make the Most of Daily Bible Reading?
start_here.author: John Piper
start_here.why: Practical counsel on choosing a reading plan that fits your time, pace and habits.

start_here.title: How to Read the Bible Like the Early Church Did
start_here.author: Patrick Schreiner
start_here.why: What modern readers lose by dismissing the church's older ways of reading Scripture.

key_number.text: Asked dozens of general Bible knowledge questions, around 2 in 3 American Christian churchgoers (65%) earned an F, scoring below 60.
